title: Understanding the Parameter Vector
text: The parameter vector, often denoted as theta, contains the coefficients that multiply each column of the design matrix X. Think about how many columns X has and how that relates to the length of theta.

title: Intercept in the Design Matrix
text: Remember that the design matrix X includes a column for the intercept. This means that even if you have $$n$$ predictors, X will have $$n+1$$ columns.

hintAnswer: X must be invertible to achieve a unique solution.
title: Exploring Matrix Invertibility
text: Consider the conditions under which a matrix is invertible. Does X need to be invertible for OLS to work?
choices: X must be invertible to achieve a unique solution.
Tina can use either MSE or MAE as her loss function.
The parameter vector theta minimizes the sum of the residuals $$(Y-hatY)$$.
The length of the parameter vector theta is equal to $$n$$.
